headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 13, 2026**
article:
The Miami Marlins secured a thrilling 8-3 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Liam Hicks leading the charge at the plate. Sandy Alcantara pitched a strong 8.0 innings, striking out 7 and allowing 3 earned runs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups and rotations. Miguel Andujar, the San Diego Padres' designated hitter, has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain. The New York Yankees have also placed CF Trent Grisham on the 10-day injured list with a right hamstring strain. Other notable injuries include Spencer Strider (Atlanta Braves), Coleman Crow (Milwaukee Brewers), Chase Dollander (Colorado Rockies), Seth Lugo (Kansas City Royals), Brent Rooker (Athletics), and Ramón Urías (St. Louis Cardinals).

The Cleveland Guardians made their first trade of the season, sending RF Nolan Jones and cash to the Chicago White Sox in exchange for future considerations. The Detroit Tigers acquired RHP Jacob Waguespack from the Milwaukee Brewers. Additionally, the Chicago White Sox traded RF Derek Hill and other considerations to the Philadelphia Phillies for CF Dylan Campbell and 2B Jose Colmenares.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Pirates in 8-3 Thriller**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured an 8-3 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Liam Hicks leading the charge at the plate. Sandy Alcantara pitched a strong 8.0 innings, striking out 7 and allowing 3 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Mariners Cruise Past Nationals 10-2**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners dominated the Washington Nationals, securing a 10-2 victory. Bryce Miller led the way for the Mariners, pitching 8.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: Baltimore Orioles Takes 3-7 Win
top_news.summary: Baltimore Orioles win 7-3 behind Gunnar Henderson's 3 hits, including a home run, and a strong relief outing from Wandy Peralta.

top_news.title: **Tigers Fall Short in Cleveland**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers dropped a 2-3 decision to the Cleveland Guardians, unable to overcome a strong performance from the Guardians' pitching staff. Spencer Torkelson led the Tigers at the plate, hitting his 11th home run of the season.

top_news.title: **Padres Place Andujar on 10-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Miguel Andujar, the San Diego Padres' designated hitter, has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain. The move is retroactive to June 11, 2026.

top_news.title: **Cleveland Guardians Make Trade Debut**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians have made their first trade of the season, sending RF Nolan Jones and cash to the Chicago White Sox in exchange for future considerations.
